findings.detail: 'type' is Py_INCREF'd via Py_NewRef() with no NULL guard, but it can be NULL via a __new__/subclass bypass of tp_init (T.__new__(T) leaves it NULL). A guard such as 'type != Py_None' or 'Py_IsNone(type)' does NOT protect this — after the bypass the field is NULL. Add 'if (type == NULL)' (or initialize it in tp_new) before the deref.

_sample.method: the scanner was RE-RUN over exactly these files; every count in this report is sample-scoped. This is not a post-hoc filter of a corpus-wide scan -- a filtered report keeps corpus-wide denominators next to sample-scoped findings, which makes an unearned zero look earned.
